```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: n8n
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: postgres-secret
  namespace: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: changeUser
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: changePassword
  POSTGRES_DB: n8n
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER: changeUser
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD: changePassword
  PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: n8n-secret
  namespace: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DB_TYPE: postgresdb
  DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST: postgres
  DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT: "5432"
  DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE: n8n
  DB_POSTGRESDB_USER: changeUser
  DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD: changePassword
  N8N_RUNNERS_MODE: external
  N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN: changeRunnerAuthToken
  N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0
  N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI: http://n8n:5679
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: postgres-init
  namespace: n8n
data:
  init-data.sh: |
    #!/bin/bash
    set -e;

    if [ -n "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER:-}" ] && [ -n "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
    	psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username "$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" <<-EOSQL
    		CREATE USER ${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER} WITH PASSWORD '${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD}';
    		GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE ${POSTGRES_DB} TO ${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER};
    		GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO ${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER};
    	EOSQL
    else
    	echo "SETUP INFO: No Environment variables given!"
    fi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: postgres-pvc
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: n8n-pvc
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: postgres
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:18
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: postgres-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: init-data
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-data.sh
              subPath: init-data.sh
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - sh
                - -c
                - pg_isready -h localhost -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 10
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - sh
                - -c
                - pg_isready -h localhost -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
        - name: db-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: postgres-pvc
        - name: init-data
          configMap:
            name: postgres-init
            defaultMode: 0755
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  selector:
    app: postgres
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: n8n
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: n8n
          image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:2.43.5
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 5678
            - name: broker
              containerPort: 5679
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: n8n-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: n8n-storage
              mountPath: /home/node/.n8n
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
        - name: n8n-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: n8n-pvc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  selector:
    app: n8n
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 5678
      targetPort: 5678
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n-runner
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n-runner
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: n8n-runner
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: n8n-runner
          image: n8nio/runners:2.43.5
          env:
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
```
